# ghost/decisions

Decisions (F-Droid): weigh a decision on a balance. Create an issue, add pros and cons with a weight from -10 to 10 and watch the scale tip. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/decisions
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/decisions open_issues --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/decisions new_issue --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/decisions add_argument --device <serial> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/decisions get_issue --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/decisions list_issues --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_issues`: Open the Decisions pros and cons app
- `new_issue`: Start a pros and cons list called Buy a new phone
- `add_argument`: Add the argument Cheaper with weight 5 to my decision
- `get_issue`: What arguments are on my decision?
- `list_issues`: List my saved decisions
